findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The two ice dispensers on the soda machines were observed with black debris on the inner surfaces. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that ice dispensers are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent buildup and any contamination of ice/drinks.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.11(E) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (E) Except when dry cleaning methods are used as specified under § 4-603.11, surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting FOOD that is not TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be cleaned: (1) At any time when contamination may have occurred; (2) At least every 24 hours for iced tea dispensers and CONSUMER self service UTENSILS such as tongs, scoops, or ladles; (3) Before restocking CONSUMER self-service EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS such as condiment dispensers and display containers; and (4) In EQUIPMENT such as ice bins and BEVERAGE dispensing nozzles and enclosed components of EQUIPMENT such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, BEVERAGE and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending EQUIPMENT: (a) At a frequency specified by the manufacturer, or (b) Absent manufacturer specifications, at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: There were several sub sandwiches and chicken salad sandwiches that lacked date marking inside of the prep cooler (near hot cases). Discussed with person-in-charge (PIC) if Time/Temperature Control foods are stored in house longer than 24 hours, date marking is required. The sandwiches are prepped in house and placed inside of the floor cooler for grab and go services. Ensure that TCS foods are marked with the date of preparation and discarded if held longer than seven days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Overall, the kitchen where food prep occurs could use a deep cleaning. There is accumulated dried food debris, flour, splatter, and other debris observed in the following areas of the kitchen:
- Bottom shelf of the main cookline cooler
- Countertops around fryers, prep tables, and under and around pieces of equipment
There was also lots of clutter on the counter across from the second prep cooler.
Ensure that physical facilities are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mop buckets storing waste water in the back storage area and along the hallway near the back door. The wastewater appears to have been sitting for a while and was not currently in use. Discussed properly disposing wastewater after use with the PIC. Ensure that wastewater is disposed of in a proper manner as this might attract unwanted insects/pests.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.114 Maintaining Premises, Unnecessary Items and Litter. The PREMISES shall be free of: (A) Items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment such as EQUIPMENT that is nonfunctional or no longer used; and (B) Litter.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
At the start of the inspection, there wasn't a sanitizer bucket available in the kitchen area. A sani bucket was created by the PIC during the inspection. Ensure that sanitizer solutions are available while food preparation is occurring. 

4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair. 

The hand sink in the kitchen sprays water from the back of the faucet when that water is turned all the way on. Repair prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools. 

A mop is observed stored with the head submerged in soiled water. Ensure mops are stored so that the bristles hang and dry.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
The employee on shift stated he had a CFM license. He was unable to find the certificate. Ensure copies of employee certificates are kept at the store. There were no other CFMs at the store during the inspection. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the area behind the soda nozzles and under the slushy nozzles to be soiled with mold and other debris. Ensure these surfaces are cleaned frequently so they are maintained clean. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
A wet mop was observed sitting in the mop bucket and not in a position that allows it to air dry easily. Ensure mops are placed or hung in a position that allows them to air dry. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-501.114  (P) Quaternary ammonium sanitizer measured 100 ppm at three compartment sink. Maintain concentration at 200 ppm to 400 ppm as indicated on manufacturer's label. Reference 4-501.114.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A)  (Pf) Donut machine (food contact surface) is soiled with dust, dirt, food residue and other debris. Wash, rinse, sanitize food-contact surfaces routinely. Reference 4-601.11(A).

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11  (C) Food stored in an unapproved location. Food shall be protected by contamination by storing it: 1) in a clean, dry location; 2) where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination; 3) at least 6 inches above the floor. Reference 3-305.11.

Observed boxes on ground within walk-in freezer. PIC was made aware of violation.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11 (C) Observed pizza delivery bag and pizza boxes above clean trays in kitchen prep area. Ensure storage of non-food contact items are separated from food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11 (Pf) Observed no sani buckets being used to sanitize food contact surfaces. Cleaning rags were stored under 3 compartment sink, then dipped in sanitizer section before use. Ensure that separate sani buckets are used when sanitizing food contact surfaces such as counters for food prep.
